title: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., to Attend Nareit’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference
summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. ### Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., to Attend Nareit’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference


November 4, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/352443609/files/doc_news/Sabra-Health-Care-REIT-Inc--to-Attend-Nareits-REITworld-2026-Annual-Conference-2026.pdf)


TUSTIN, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabrahealth.com&esheet=54634717&newsitemid=20261104764404&lan=en-US&anchor=Sabra+Health+Care+REIT%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=5f29eb029b2f7195d366f9d5069ef545) (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that Rick Matros, the company’s Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Costa, the company’s Chief Financial Officer, Darrin Smith, the company’s Chief Investment Officer, and Lukas Hartwich, the company’s Executive Vice President of Finance, will attend Nareit’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference November 16 – 19, 2026 at the Atlanta Marriott Marquis in Atlanta, Georgia.


**About Sabra**


[Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsabrahealth.com%2F&esheet=54634717&newsitemid=20261104764404&lan=en-US&anchor=Sabra+Health+Care+REIT%2C+Inc.&index=2&md5=92606f7ff95bcc03a897cd39c4df9c50) , a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a “REIT”) that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada.


Investor & Media Inquiries: 1-888-393-8248 orinvestorinquiries@sabrahealth.com
